title: My favorite gaming earbuds got their first discount
summary: Asus Cetra Open wireless earbuds are on sale for $206.99 at Amazon and Best Buy, offering open-style audio design that allows awareness of surroundings while gaming. The earbuds feature impressive battery life, customization options, and a USB-C transmitter with passthrough charging support up to 60W.
content:
Asus’ Cetra Open wireless earbuds are some of the best that I’ve tested, despite being open-style earbuds. Their drivers sit outside of your ear, which allows outside sounds to mix with audio coming from your console. Some gamers may not want this, but it works well for me as someone who prefers to be aware of their surroundings as they play or listen to podcasts. They’re $22 off at Amazon and Best Buy, costing $206.99.
In addition to their great-sounding audio and respectable battery life (plus surprisingly deep customization through a mobile or browser-based app), the Cetra Open ship with a clever USB-C 2.4GHz transmitter that has a built-in port for passthrough charging. In other words, you can charge as you play instead of forgoing a USB-C port for audio. The built-in port supports up to 60W of passthrough charging, but it can’t be used as a data port.
Asus Cetra Open Wireless earbuds

The Cetra Open are as good of a fit for the likes of the Steam Deck, PC, Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 as they are for your phone. They’re a breeze to connect via Bluetooth and use for music and podcasts, and there’s also a reflective band included that physically links them together behind your neck for improved visibility and stability if you want to run with them.

title: Nintendo Direct September 2026: The biggest news and trailers
summary: Nintendo's September 2026 Direct presentation showcased Switch 2 releases including Metroid Ravenous (January 2027), Kirby and the World Beyond (Spring 2027), Persona 6, and other major titles launching this winter and beyond. The 45-minute show highlighted Nintendo's major releases alongside updates on previously announced games.
content:
Nintendo just wrapped part two of its double feature this week.
On Tuesday, the company hosted a showcase all about the Legend of Zelda franchise, including footage and a November 5th release date for the Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake. On Wednesday, the company aired a new Nintendo Direct, which spotlighted Switch 2 games mostly “launching this winter” over the course of about 45 minutes.
The show wasn’t a blockbuster one, but it had a few notable announcements. A new 2D Metroid game, Metroid Ravenous, launches in January. The Kirby franchise is getting a new game, Kirby and the World Beyond, sometime in spring 2027. A Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Pikmin 4 releases in November. And Persona 6 will be coming to the Switch 2, though that game still doesn’t have a release date.
This year’s other big releases include Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave on September 17th and Nintendo Switch Sports Resort on October 22nd. For 2027, major new entries in the Pokémon and Xenoblade franchises are already on the calendar, but they don’t have specific dates yet.
Follow our coverage of the September 2026 Nintendo Direct right here. You can watch a replay of the show on YouTube.

title: Group of bipartisan lawmakers ask US government to ban several hack-for-hire firms
summary: A bipartisan group of U.S. lawmakers is calling for the government to ban three Indian companies accused of operating hack-for-hire operations. The firms are alleged to use hackers to steal information for use in litigation manipulation.
content: The three Indian companies are accused of using hackers to steal information used to sway litigation.

zh.summary: 美国跨党派议员团体呼吁政府禁止三家被指控运营黑客雇佣业务的印度公司。这些公司被指控雇用黑客窃取信息用于诉讼操纵。

title: Instacart launches an AI grocery shopping assistant called Clementine
summary: Instacart is launching Clementine, a conversational AI grocery shopping assistant, joining other delivery platforms in offering AI-powered shopping features. The assistant allows users to interact naturally with the platform to create customized carts and discover products.
content: Instacart is the latest app to bake a conversational AI assistant into its platform.

zh.title: Instacart推出名为Clementine的AI购物助手
zh.summary: Instacart推出了Clementine，一个对话式AI购物助手，加入其他配送平台行列，提供AI驱动的购物功能。该助手允许用户自然地与平台互动，创建定制的购物车并发现产品。

title: Worried Anthropic researchers warn that AI ‘could kill all humans’
summary: A senior Anthropic safety researcher has warned of a 10%+ probability that AI could cause human extinction by 2030, while a colleague publicly resigned citing concerns that AI labs are recklessly pursuing superintelligence without adequate safety controls.
content:
A senior Anthropic safety researcher has said there is more than a 10 percent chance artificial intelligence "could kill all humans" by the end of the decade, just hours after a colleague resigned over fears the AI lab and its rivals are carelessly racing to build "superhuman systems" they cannot control. 
In a post on X announcing his departure, Jacob Coxon, a researcher who has trained AI systems at Anthropic, said he had quit the company over its lax approach to safety. Coxon, who previously trained systems for OpenAI, accused the two AI companies of "racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives," even  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

title: Google DeepMind alumni are building tools to accelerate fusion power for the grid
summary: Fusionality, founded by Google DeepMind alumni, is developing control systems and simulation tools to help fusion power startups accelerate their development and time-to-market.
content: Fusionality is developing control systems and simulation environments to help fusion power startups move faster.

title: Apple’s foldable ‘iPhone Duo’ will reportedly start at $2,000
summary: Apple's upcoming foldable iPhone, reportedly named iPhone Duo, will start at $2,000 for the 256GB model with higher-storage variants up to 2TB reaching approximately $3,000; the device is expected to ship in October in white and dark blue.
content:
With only a few hours left until the first iPhone launch event since John Ternus took over as the CEO of Apple, Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman says the name of the company's long-rumored folding phone is the iPhone Duo. The midnight report suggests it will have a price starting at $2,000 for a model with 256GB of storage, or around $3,000 for up to 2TB. Shipping is said to start as soon as October in two colors: white and dark blue.

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: 苹果即将推出的可折叠iPhone,据报道名为iPhone Duo,256GB型号起价2000美元,更高存储容量版本(最高达2TB)将达到约3000美元;该设备预计将在十月份以白色和深蓝色推出。

title: CloudNC raises $20M to automate manufacturing’s most pressing bottlenecks
summary: UK-based manufacturing software company CloudNC announced a $20M Series B extension, bringing its total funding to $128M to automate key bottlenecks in manufacturing processes.
content: UK-based manufacturing software startup CloudNC announced Wednesday a $20 million B extension round, bringing its lifetime total raised amount to $128 million.
